raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

MiniMax-M3.1 NVFP4 checkpoints currently serve their MoE layers only through MegaMoE (`--moe-a2a-backend megamoe`) or the routed TRT-LLM kernel. This PR adds a DeepEP expert-parallel path built on FlashInfer CuteDSL:

- DeepEP low-latency dispatch sends **pre-quantized NVFP4 activations with per-token FP32 scales**. That is 4-bit payload on the wire instead of BF16, with no requantization on the receiving rank.
- The FlashInfer CuteDSL **masked grouped GEMM** runs GEMM1 with SwiGLU (including the M3.1 clamped / `swigluoai` variant) and NVFP4 output quantization fused into the epilogue. The intermediate activation never round-trips through BF16 memory.

**Dependencies (this PR must land after them):**
- DeepEP: sgl-project/DeepEP#16. This adds `Buffer.low_latency_dispatch_fp4` with `per_token_scale` and swizzled scale output. A follow-up bumps the `sgl-deep-ep` wheel once it is released.
- FlashInfer: flashinfer-ai/flashinfer#7850 (fused gated activation in the masked grouped GEMM epilogue) and flashinfer-ai/flashinfer#7851 (NVFP4 output quantization in that epilogue).

There is no silent fallback. If the DeepEP build lacks `low_latency_dispatch_fp4`, or the FlashInfer build lacks the fused epilogue, startup fails with an explicit error.

## Modifications

- **`token_dispatcher/deepep.py`**
  - With `nvfp4_per_token_activation`, the LL dispatcher quantizes tokens with `flashinfer.nvfp4_quantize(per_token_activation=True)` (linear block scales, FP32 per-token scale).
  - It then calls `Buffer.low_latency_dispatch_fp4(..., per_token_scale=..., swizzle_scales=True)`.
  - `DeepEPLLDispatchOutput` gains an optional `per_token_scale`.
- **`flashinfer_cutedsl_moe.py`**
  - New `flashinfer_cutedsl_moe_masked_fused_swiglu`. GEMM1 uses `activation_type=Swiglu` with separate gate/up alphas, per-token activation scales and NVFP4 output; GEMM2 is the existing masked GEMM.
  - If an NVFP4 recipe override is set (`FLASHINFER_NVFP4_4OVER6`, disabled fast-math quantization), GEMM1 emits BF16 and a separate grouped quantize runs, so the dispatch and GEMM2 recipes stay consistent.
  - New `supports_masked_gemm_fused_swiglu()` capability probe (SM100/SM103 plus the FlashInfer API).
- **`moe_runner/flashinfer_cutedsl.py`**
  - `CuteDslFp4MoeQuantInfo` carries `w1_alpha_up` and the SwiGLU `(alpha, beta, limit)`.
  - The DeepEP fused function picks the per-token path when the dispatch output carries `per_token_scale`.
- **`quantization/minimax_m3_nvfp4.py`**
  - New CuteDSL weight processing. It reorders W13 to `[up; gate]` and interleaves 64-row halves for the fused epilogue, with block scales permuted the same way and then swizzled.
  - It derives per-expert gate/up alphas from the two W13 global scales and the GEMM2 alpha from the W2 input scale.
  - It builds a `FLASHINFER_CUTEDSL` MoE runner and configures the dispatcher for per-token NVFP4.
- **`arg_groups`**
  - `--moe-runner-backend flashinfer_cutedsl` is accepted for `minimax_m3_nvfp4` with `--moe-a2a-backend deepep`; DeepEP mode resolves to `low_latency`.
  - A startup check rejects configs whose prefill chunk / prefill graph / decode graph exceeds `SGLANG_DEEPEP_NUM_MAX_DISPATCH_TOKENS_PER_RANK`. LL dispatch serves prefill too, so without this check the error would be a DeepEP assert during graph capture.
- **Tests**
  - New `test/registered/kernels/ops/moe/test_minimax_m31_nvfp4_cutedsl_moe.py` (single GPU, SM100) runs the full DeepEP-LL-format to CuteDSL MoE path against a dequantized reference. It covers uneven routing, an empty expert, distinct gate/up global scales, a non-unit W2 input scale, and NaN scales in unused rows.
  - Both fused-NVFP4-output and BF16-output GEMM1 are parametrized, plus a rejection test when the fused epilogue is unavailable.

Launch:

```bash
SGLANG_DEEPEP_NUM_MAX_DISPATCH_TOKENS_PER_RANK=1024 \
python -m sglang.launch_server --model-path <MiniMax-M3.1 NVFP4> --trust-remote-code \
  --tp-size 8 --ep-size 8 \
  --moe-a2a-backend deepep --deepep-mode low_latency --moe-runner-backend flashinfer_cutedsl \
  --chunked-prefill-size 1024 --cuda-graph-max-bs-prefill 1024
```

## Accuracy Tests

Setup: 8x B200, TP8/EP8, colocated, decode CUDA graph + breakable prefill CUDA graph, FP8 KV cache. Built against DeepEP#16 and FlashInfer#7850 + #7851.

GSM8K (5-shot, 500 questions, greedy):

| MoE path | GSM8K |
|---|---|
| MegaMoE (default) | 0.964 |
| **DeepEP LL NVFP4 dispatch + CuteDSL fused SwiGLU (this PR)** | **0.960** |

Unit test: `test_minimax_m31_nvfp4_cutedsl_moe.py`, 3 passed.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

`bench_one_batch_server`, input 1024 / output 256, same setup:

| bs | MegaMoE (default) out tok/s | This PR out tok/s | MegaMoE TTFT | This PR TTFT |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 108.1 | 103.3 | 0.11 s | 0.14 s |
| 8 | 799.7 | 721.5 | 0.12 s | 0.69 s |
| 32 | 2689.5 | 2445.9 | 0.42 s | 2.53 s |
| 64 | 4936.5 | 3410.6 | 0.74 s | 4.88 s |
| 128 | 9140.0 | 8172.6 | 1.48 s | 10.38 s |

On a single TP8 node, MegaMoE stays faster, and it remains the default. This path does not replace it; it adds a DeepEP expert-parallel option for M3.1 NVFP4.

The higher TTFT comes from DeepEP low-latency mode handling prefill: chunks are capped at 1024 tokens per rank, so prefill runs as many small LL dispatches.

Expected follow-ups:
- A DeepEP normal-mode prefill handler for this path.
- Disaggregated / multi-node deployments, where LL NVFP4 dispatch traffic is the bottleneck.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-and-profiling).

+def flashinfer_cutedsl_moe_masked_fused_swiglu(
+    hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+    hidden_states_scale: torch.Tensor,
+    per_token_scale: torch.Tensor,
+    w1: torch.Tensor,
+    w1_blockscale: torch.Tensor,
+    w1_alpha: torch.Tensor,
+    w1_alpha_up: torch.Tensor,
+    w2: torch.Tensor,
+    a2_global_scale: torch.Tensor,
+    w2_blockscale: torch.Tensor,
+    w2_alpha: torch.Tensor,
+    masked_m: torch.Tensor,
+    swiglu_alpha: float,
+    swiglu_beta: float,
+    swiglu_limit: float,
+    down_sm_count: Optional[int] = None,
+    down_signals: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+    down_start_event: Optional[torch.cuda.Event] = None,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Masked NVFP4 MoE with per-token activation scales and a fused SwiGLU GEMM1.
+
+    GEMM1 applies the per-token and per-expert scales and the clamped SwiGLU in
+    its epilogue and, under FlashInfer's default NVFP4 recipe, also quantizes
+    its output for GEMM2.
+
+    Args:
+        hidden_states: [l, m, k // 2] uint8, packed E2M1 activations.
+        hidden_states_scale: E4M3 block scales of hidden_states in the swizzled
+            (32, 4, rm, 4, rk, l) layout.
+        per_token_scale: [l, m] float32 dequantization scale of each row.
+        w1: [l, 2 * n, k // 2] uint8, gate/up rows interleaved in 64-row
+            blocks with the up projection first.
+        w1_blockscale: swizzled E4M3 block scales of w1.
+        w1_alpha, w1_alpha_up: [l] float32 dequantization scales of the gate
+            and up projections.
+        w2: [l, k, n // 2] uint8.
+        a2_global_scale: [l] float32 NVFP4 global scale of the GEMM2 input.
+        w2_blockscale: swizzled E4M3 block scales of w2.
+        w2_alpha: [l] float32 GEMM2 dequantization scale.
+        masked_m: [l] int32 valid rows per expert.
+        swiglu_alpha, swiglu_beta, swiglu_limit: the activation is
+            gate * sigmoid(swiglu_alpha * gate) * (up + swiglu_beta), with gate
+            clamped above and up clamped on both sides at swiglu_limit.
+
+    Returns:
+        [l, m, k] bfloat16.
+    """
+    from flashinfer import ActivationType
+
+    num_experts, m, k_by_2 = hidden_states.shape
+    k = k_by_2 * 2
+    n = w2.shape[-1] * 2
+    assert hidden_states.dtype == torch.uint8, hidden_states.dtype
+    assert per_token_scale.shape == (num_experts, m), per_token_scale.shape
+    assert w1.shape == (num_experts, 2 * n, k_by_2), w1.shape
+    assert w2.shape == (num_experts, k, n // 2), w2.shape
+    for name, scale in (
+        ("w1_alpha", w1_alpha),
+        ("w1_alpha_up", w1_alpha_up),
+        ("a2_global_scale", a2_global_scale),
+        ("w2_alpha", w2_alpha),
+    ):
+        assert scale.dtype == torch.float32 and scale.shape == (num_experts,), (
+            f"{name} must be float32 of shape ({num_experts},), got "
+            f"{scale.dtype} {tuple(scale.shape)}"
+        )
+
+    device = hidden_states.device
+    sf_vec_size = 16
+    gemm_kwargs = dict(
+        ab_dtype="float4_e2m1fn", sf_dtype="float8_e4m3fn", sf_vec_size=sf_vec_size
+    )
+    gemm1_kwargs = dict(
+        activation_type=ActivationType.Swiglu,

+    gs = (448 * 6 / w.abs().amax()).float().reshape(1)
+    q, sf = fp4_quantize(w, gs, 16, False, False)
+    sf = sf.view(torch.float8_e4m3fn).reshape(w.shape[0], -1)
+    return q.view(torch.uint8), sf, gs, _dequant(q.view(torch.uint8), sf, gs, w.shape)
+
+
+def _fake_quant_per_token(a):
+    """What dynamic per-token NVFP4 activation quantization keeps of `a`."""
+    return torch.cat([_quantize(row[None].bfloat16())[3] for row in a])
+
+
+def _swigluoai(x):
+    gate, up = x.chunk(2, -1)
+    gate, up = gate.clamp(max=LIMIT), up.clamp(-LIMIT, LIMIT)
+    return gate * torch.sigmoid(ALPHA * gate) * (up + 1)
+
+
+def _build_layer(gate_up_scale_ratio: float):
+    layer = torch.nn.Module()
+    w13 = torch.randn(E, 2 * I, H, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16) / 4
+    # Distinct gate and up global scales catch a dropped alpha_up.
+    w13[:, I:] *= gate_up_scale_ratio
+    w2 = torch.randn(E, H, I, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16) / 8
+    gate = [_quantize(w[:I]) for w in w13]
+    up = [_quantize(w[I:]) for w in w13]
+    q2, s2, g2, d2 = zip(*(_quantize(w) for w in w2))
+    params = dict(
+        w13_weight_packed=torch.stack(
+            [torch.cat((g[0], u[0])) for g, u in zip(gate, up)]
+        ),
+        w13_weight_scale=torch.stack(
+            [torch.cat((g[1], u[1])) for g, u in zip(gate, up)]
+        ),
+        w13_weight_global_scale=torch.stack(
+            [torch.cat((g[2], u[2])) for g, u in zip(gate, up)]
+        ),
+        w13_input_global_scale=torch.full((E, 2), 1.0, device="cuda"),
+        w2_weight_packed=torch.stack(q2),
+        w2_weight_scale=torch.stack(s2),
+        w2_weight_global_scale=torch.cat(g2),
+        # Non-unit so a dropped or double-applied fc2 input scale shows up.
+        w2_input_global_scale=torch.full((E,), 2.0, device="cuda"),
+    )
+    for name, t in params.items():
+        layer.register_parameter(name, torch.nn.Parameter(t, requires_grad=False))
+    layer.num_experts = layer.num_local_experts = E
+    layer.moe_ep_rank = 0
+    layer.intermediate_size_per_partition = I
+    layer._minimax_activation = "swigluoai"
+    layer.dispatcher = mock.Mock()
+    layer.moe_runner_config = MoeRunnerConfig(
+        num_experts=E,
+        num_local_experts=E,
+        hidden_size=H,
+        intermediate_size_per_partition=I,
+        top_k=TOPK,
+        gemm1_alpha=ALPHA,
+        gemm1_beta=1.0,
+        gemm1_clamp_limit=LIMIT,
+        inplace=False,
+    )
+    d13 = torch.stack([torch.cat((g[3], u[3])) for g, u in zip(gate, up)])
+    return layer, d13, torch.stack(d2)
+
+
+def _reference(x, ids, weights, d13, d2):
+    out = torch.zeros(x.shape, device="cuda", dtype=torch.float32)
+    xq = _fake_quant_per_token(x)
+    for k in range(TOPK):
+        h = _swigluoai(torch.einsum("th,tnh->tn", xq, d13[ids[:, k]]))
+        # GEMM2 input uses the static per-expert FC2 input scale (2.0).
+        gs = 2.0
+        q, sf = _fp4_static(h, gs)
+        h = _dequant(q, sf, gs, h.shape)
+        out += weights[:, k : k + 1] * torch.einsum("ti,thi->th", h, d2[ids[:, k]])
+    return out
+
+
+def _fp4_static(h, gs):
+    from flashinfer import fp4_quantize
+
+    q, sf = fp4_quantize(
+        h.bfloat16(), torch.tensor([gs], device="cuda"), 16, False, False
+    )
+    return q.view(torch.uint8), sf.view(torch.float8_e4m3fn).reshape(h.shape[0], -1)
+
+
+def _ll_dispatch(x, ids, weights, capacity):
+    """Single-rank stand-in for DeepEP low_latency_dispatch_fp4(swizzle_scales=True)."""
+    q, sf, pts = _quantize_per_token_nvfp4(x)
+    recv_x = torch.zeros(E, capacity, H // 2, dtype=torch.uint8, device="cuda")
+    recv_sf = torch.zeros(E, capacity, H // 16, dtype=torch.uint8, device="cuda")
+    # Garbage in unused rows must not leak into valid outputs.
+    recv_pts = torch.full((E, capacity), float("nan"), device="cuda")
+    counts = torch.zeros(E, dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda")
+    slots = []
+    for t in range(x.shape[0]):
+        for k in range(TOPK):
+            e = int(ids[t, k])
+            r = int(counts[e])
+            recv_x[e, r], recv_sf[e, r], recv_pts[e, r] = q[t], sf[t], pts[t]
+            counts[e] += 1
+            slots.append((t, k, e, r))
+    rm, rk = capacity // 128, H // 64
+    swizzled = (
+        swizzle_blockscale(recv_sf.view(torch.float8_e4m3fn))
+        .view(E, rm, rk, 32, 4, 4)
+        .permute(3, 4, 1, 5, 2, 0)
+    )
+    dispatch = DeepEPLLDispatchOutput(
+        hidden_states=recv_x,
+        hidden_states_scale=swizzled,
+        topk_ids=ids,
+        topk_weights=weights,
+        masked_m=counts,
+        expected_m=capacity,
+        per_token_scale=recv_pts,
+    )
+    return dispatch, slots
+
+
+def _scheme():
+    with (
+        mock.patch.object(
+            minimax_m3_nvfp4,
+            "get_moe_runner_backend",
+            return_value=MoeRunnerBackend.FLASHINFER_CUTEDSL,
+        ),
+        mock.patch.object(
+            minimax_m3_nvfp4, "get_moe_a2a_backend", return_value=MoeA2ABackend.DEEPEP
+        ),
+    ):
+        return minimax_m3_nvfp4.MiniMaxM3Nvfp4MoE()
+
+
+@requires_fused_masked_gemm
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("fused_nvfp4_output", [True, False])
+def test_cutedsl_masked_matches_dequantized_reference(fused_nvfp4_output, monkeypatch):
+    if not fused_nvfp4_output:
+        # Falls back to a BF16 GEMM1 output and a separate quantize kernel.
+        monkeypatch.setenv("FLASHINFER_DISABLE_FP4_QUANT_FAST_MATH", "1")
+    torch.manual_seed(0)
+    scheme = _scheme()
+    assert scheme.use_flashinfer_cutedsl and not scheme.load_up_proj_weight_first
+    layer, d13, d2 = _build_layer(gate_up_scale_ratio=3.0)
+    scheme.process_weights_after_loading(layer)
+    layer.dispatcher.set_quant_config.assert_called_once_with(
+        {"dispatcher_output_dtype": "nvfp4", "nvfp4_per_token_activation": True}
+    )
+
+    x = torch.randn(T, H, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+    # Uneven routing: expert E - 1 receives no tokens.
+    ids = torch.stack(
+        [torch.randperm(E - 1, device="cuda")[:TOPK] for _ in range(T)]
+    ).int()
+    weights = torch.rand(T, TOPK, device="cuda").softmax(-1)
+    ref = _reference(x, ids, weights, d13, d2)
+    pre_act = torch.einsum("th,tnh->tn", x.float(), d13[ids[:, 0]])
+    assert (pre_act.abs() > LIMIT).float().mean() > 0.2
+
+    captured = {}
+    scheme.runner = SimpleNamespace(run=lambda d, q: captured.setdefault("q", q))
+    scheme.apply_weights(layer, None)
+    dispatch, slots = _ll_dispatch(x, ids, weights, capacity=256)
+    expert_out = flashinfer_cutedsl.fused_experts_deepep_to_flashinfer_cutedsl_fp4(
+        dispatch, captured["q"], layer.moe_runner_config
+    ).hidden_states
+    assert expert_out.shape == (E, 256, H)
+
+    out = torch.zeros(T, H, device="cuda", dtype=torch.float32)
+    for t, k, e, r in slots:
+        out[t] += weights[t, k] * expert_out[e, r].float()
+    rel = ((out - ref).norm() / ref.norm()).item()
+    fit = ((out * ref).sum() / (ref * ref).sum()).item()
+    assert rel < 0.13 and abs(fit - 1) < 0.02, (rel, fit)
+
+
+def test_scheme_rejects_cutedsl_without_deepep():
+    with (
+        mock.patch.object(
+            minimax_m3_nvfp4,
+            "get_moe_runner_backend",
+            return_value=MoeRunnerBackend.FLASHINFER_CUTEDSL,
+        ),
+        mock.patch.object(
+            minimax_m3_nvfp4, "get_moe_a2a_backend", return_value=MoeA2ABackend.NONE
+        ),
+        mock.patch.object(
+            minimax_m3_nvfp4,
+            "get_platform",
+            return_value=SimpleNamespace(is_blackwell=True),
+        ),
+        pytest.raises(ValueError, match="deepep"),
+    ):
+        minimax_m3_nvfp4.MiniMaxM3Nvfp4MoE()
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    sys.exit(pytest.main([__file__, "-v"]))
